
```{r}
name <- c(
  "Alice Chen", "Bob Smith", "Charlie Davis", "Diana Prince",
  "Evan Wright", "Fiona Gallagher", "George Miller", "Hannah Abbott",
  "Ian Malcolm", "Julia Roberts", "Kevin Hart", "Laura Croft"
)

class_year <- c(
    "First Year", "First Year", "First Year", "Junior",
    "First Year", "Senior", "Junior", "Sophomore",
    "First Year", "Junior", "Junior", "Sophomore"
)

major <- c(
    "CS", "BIO", "ART", "DS", "ECO", "CS", "BIO", "ECO", "DS", "ART", "CS", "BIO"
)

students <- data.frame(name, class_year, major, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
students
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
students |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = class_year)) +
    geom_bar()
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
students |> 
    mutate(class_year = fct_relevel(
        class_year, 
        c("First Year", "Sophomore", "Junior", "Senior"))) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = class_year)) +
    geom_bar()
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
students |> 
    mutate(class_year = fct_recode(
        class_year, 
        "FY" = "First Year" , 
        "SO" = "Sophomore", 
        "JU" = "Junior",
        "SE" = "Senior")) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = class_year)) +
    geom_bar()
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
students |> 
    mutate(class_year = fct_infreq(class_year)) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = class_year)) +
    geom_bar()
```
